errors.email: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.

problems.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
problems.unreachable: We couldn’t reach Aveline. Check your connection and try again.
problems.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
problems.check: Some details weren’t accepted. Check them and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.refused: That email and password don’t match an account.

register.title: Create your account
register.lead: Then set up your organization and your first event.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We’ve sent a message to this address explaining how to sign in.

resetPassword.title: Reset your password
resetPassword.lead: We’ll email you a link to choose a new one.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: If an account uses this address, we’ve sent it a link to choose a new password. Only the newest link works, and only once.

choose.title: Choose a new password
choose.lead: Every device signed in to your account will be signed out.

resetPassword.linkInvalid: This link has expired, was already used, or a newer one was sent.

done.title: Password changed
done.body: Every device was signed out. Sign in with your new password.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.invalid: This link has expired or was already used.
verifyEmail.missing: This link is incomplete. Open it again from your email.

invite.lead: Choose a password. If this address already has an Aveline account, use its password instead.
invite.invalid: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
invite.accountExists: This address already has an account and that isn’t its password, or the account already belongs to another organization. Sign in with its password, or reset it first.
invite.missing: This invitation link is incomplete. Open it again from your email.

done.title: You’re in
done.created: Your account is ready. Sign in with this email address and the password you chose.
done.existing: The invitation is now part of your account. Sign in to continue.
